title: Facts before Judgment; epistemic statuses
issue_presented: How must an Atlas agent classify facts before judging or acting?

known_facts.fact: Task 1 found multiple JUDGMENT.md copies and overlapping governance structures.
Task 3 designated GitHub Atlas-Governance main as statute and the local docket as cabinet, not law.

evidence.note: Public docket does not carry workstation paths. The exhibit remains in the private companion.

existing_governing_law: Historical statute/JUDGMENT.md no-fabrication and source-verify gates
analysis: Without epistemic labels, agents promote guesses to Known. V2 forbids that promotion.
judgment_rule: Every material factual claim in Governance work must be labeled KNOWN, INFERRED, CONFLICTED, UNKNOWN, or USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.
KNOWN requires direct support from cited evidence.
INFERRED, CONFLICTED, and UNKNOWN must not be silently promoted to KNOWN.
USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED is used when J-0002's materiality test is met.
operational_effect: Job records and Judgments must carry these labels. Engine rejects close() when USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED items remain without a user confirmation id.
exceptions: Non-material drafting choices (identifier spelling in TEST jobs) need not be labeled.
required_validation: Test C (unknown) and engine unit checks on promotion.
